title: Intertextual Parallel Detection in Biblical Hebrew: A Transformer-Based Benchmark
findings: E5 and AlephBERT were the most effective models for detecting parallel passages in Biblical Hebrew. E5 excelled at identifying true parallels but had a higher tendency for false positives, while AlephBERT was slightly less effective on true parallels but demonstrated better differentiation between parallel and non-parallel passages. The study concludes that pre-trained models can enhance the efficiency and accuracy of detecting intertextual parallels in ancient religious texts.
